reviews.quote: We replaced three tools with one, and our release notes finally write themselves. The whole team felt the difference in the first week.

reviews.quote: Setup took an afternoon, not a sprint. Our on-call load dropped by a third, and nobody misses the old dashboards.

reviews.quote: It is the rare tool that designers and engineers both open without being asked. Handoffs went from a meeting to a link.

reviews.quote: As a five-person company we can't afford busywork. This gave us back roughly a day a week, every week.

reviews.quote: Our campaign reviews used to live in screenshots and long threads. Now every decision sits in one place, on the record.

reviews.quote: Fast, quiet and predictable: exactly how infrastructure should feel. We stopped thinking about it, which is the highest compliment.
reviews.name: Lukas Becker
